Name: (CP) Plenty of Beds
Author: Stavetskaya
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f4cccc][size=4]This mod have two versions which are replaces  beds in game with a new ones.

One version (Called Plenty'o'Beds by Stavetskaya (Industrial set Edition)) have space left for two of Industrial Furniture Set beds I like the most, so if you will use it along, place my mod [/size][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffff00][size=4]AFTER[/size][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#f4cccc] the Industrial Set Furniture. [/color]

[color=#ffd966](To do so just add "z" to the folder,
so name of the folder will look like [CP]zPlenty'o'Beds by Stavetskaya (Industrial set Edition))[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]Second one (Called Plenty'o'Beds by Stavetskaya Full Edition) replace every bed in the game, including child beds.[/color]

[/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][color=#f4cccc]It is fully safe to install and uninstall this mod in your game in any time. [/color]

[size=6][u][color=#ff0000]REQUIREMENTS:
[/color][/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
[/url][/size][center][color=#f4cccc][size=6]
[/size][size=5]Thank you for reading and attention![/size]
[size=3](Please, if you like it don't forget to endorse. For me it's quite important)[/size]
[size=5]Enjoy your game![/size]
